messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore presents a compelling case for the science of climate change and its global impact. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original film, this sequel examines progress (or lack thereof) in addressing climate change and highlights new scientific findings. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the effects of climate change and discusses solutions. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A BBC documentary that explains the science behind climate change, its impacts, and potential mitigation strategies. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film explores the environmental crisis and offers a vision for a sustainable future. |
| **Our Planet** (Season 1) | 2019 | While not solely focused on climate change, this nature series highlights how global warming threatens ecosystems worldwide. |

These documentaries are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or through their respective official websites. They provide a mix of scientific explanation, personal testimony, and calls to action that can help you understand the urgency of addressing global warming.
